mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_llm_config (user_id, model_code, api_key_ciphertext, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{modelCode}, #{apiKeyCiphertext}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET model_code = EXCLUDED.model_code, api_key_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.api_key_ciphertext, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
